name: agent-progress
description: Progress bar above the prompt for subagent work, plus a live agents panel (/agent-progress) with model, steps, context, estimated cost and time. Works with any subagents; no workflow skill required.

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel by itself
autoOpen.description: plan: when the main session reports a plan; any: also when any subagent starts; session: once when each session starts; never: only with /agent-progress or the band's button

stepBrief.title: Ask subagents to report steps
stepBrief.description: all: append a one-line request to every subagent's prompt asking it to report its steps with the step tool; none: leave prompts alone (rows then show context fill instead of step progress)
